items.prompt: I can't speak German, and ___ can my brother.
___ had we left the office when the alarm went off.
items.explanation: 'Hardly... when' triggers inversion after the fronted negative adverb.

items.prompt: ___ I known earlier, I would have prepared better.
Complete with one word: She loves the project, and so ___ her team.
Rewrite without 'if': "If I had known, I would have stayed."
answers: Had I known, I would have stayed
items.explanation: Formal inversion moves 'had' to the front.

items.prompt: Rewrite starting with 'Scarcely': "The plane had taken off when the engine failed."
answers: Scarcely had the plane taken off when the engine failed
items.explanation: 'Scarcely' at the front inverts the subject and auxiliary.
